Method of Attack: Uses a domain generation algorithm (DGA) to generate new domains at regular intervals to bypass ad blockers
Deploys in-browser cryptocurrency miners (Coinhive Monero miner) hidden in ads
Uses alternative domains generated by DGA to serve ads and cryptojacking scripts when ad blockers are detected
Impacted Systems: Web browsers on customer sites serving ads
Sites offering free downloads or adult content
Attack Vector: Malicious advertising network serving ads with embedded cryptojacking scripts
Indicators of Compromise: Ads served from domains generated by the DGA.popad algorithm
Presence of Coinhive in-browser Monero miner scripts in ads
High traffic to random domains generated by the DGA, including one in Alexa Top 2,000
